**Finding: missing (medium severity) — no post-termination transition or data-return provision.**

What I checked:
- **Section 4 (Term; Termination; Termination Payment)** — covers only notice periods, the defined "Termination Date," and the Company's Termination Payment obligation. No exit mechanics.
- **Section 1.4** — grants the Company access to HDI's system and content administration tools, but only during the term.
- **Section 8 (Confidentiality)** — HDI must protect Content, user information and data, but has no obligation to return or delete it.
- **Section 10.7 (Survival)** — survives Sections 6.3, 7, 9 and 10 only; no exit obligation to survive.

Why this fails the fallback: HDI hosts the Site on its own server and holds our Content, user information and customer/order data. With no return, export or migration obligation anywhere, we sit below the 90-day/30-day fallback and near the walk-away position (no data return).

Redline (validated, ok:true): new **Section 4.3** inserted after p0029 at the preferred position — up to six months' transition assistance at HDI's then-current rates including Site migration cooperation, machine-readable return of all Company Content and data within 30 days of the Termination Date, then deletion certified in writing. The comment flags that a 90-day assistance tail is an acceptable fallback if HDI pushes back.
